page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance based on KVM hypervisor virtualization. The system is equipped with an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. It delivers 64 dedicated virtual cores paired with 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced resource density of 4 GB of memory per core. The configuration includes no discrete graphics processing units.

Integrated local block storage is not present on the ecs.g8ae.16xlarge, making persistent workloads reliant on remote cloud storage volumes. High-throughput communication between nodes and external storage infrastructure is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addressing.

With its 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio, the instance provides balanced resource utilization without excessive memory overhead. The lack of onboard ephemeral NVMe drives requires consideration for storage latency across network-attached volumes. This architecture fits multi-tier enterprise systems, distributed databases, large-scale container workers, and web application clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.16xlarge is a general-purpose compute instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz. The instance delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4 GB memory-per-vCPU balance. It does not incorporate local storage disks, requiring external cloud disks for persistent storage operations, and contains no discrete GPU accelerators. High-bandwidth communication is accommodated via a 32 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With its balanced processor and memory profile, the ecs.g8ae.16xlarge instance accommodates large-scale enterprise services, multi-tenant container hosts, high-volume web application tiers, and distributed database systems requiring consistent multi-core processing without relying on local ephemeral storage hardware.
